text:
JUDGE BURST L2-jdg-plate — which scene plate shares the CHARACTER'S camera. task_id "L2-jdg-plate". You are a separate instance: you have not seen any prompt, receipt or prior judgment and must not look for one.

Images 1–3 each show the SAME painted character (five poses) composited onto a stone observatory floor with a compass-rose inlay. The character art is fixed; only the floor painting differs. Judge each image independently: 1 camera_match 1–5 (do the figures look like they were drawn from the same camera as the floor — feet sitting ON the floor plane, the floor foreshortened by the same amount the figures are, rather than cut-outs standing on a floor seen from much higher above); 2 scale 1–5 (figure size plausible against the floor bands, props and steps visible); 3 register 1–5 (floor and figures look like one hand-drawn painted style); 4 playable_space 1–5 (open floor to move around, props at the edges, nothing confusing about where you can walk). One-line reason each. Then name best (image number) with one line why.
Write out/judgment.json {"candidates":[{"image":n,"scores":{"camera_match":n,"scale":n,"register":n,"playable_space":n},"reasons":{…}}],"best":n,"why":"…"}. No image_gen. No code. No web. No files outside out/. calls_used 0.
RETURN: receipt task_id "L2-jdg-plate"; images []; files [out/judgment.json + sha256]; status. Never PASS/FAIL.
